stage0061_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$リツコ$$
「...What's wrong, $$ミサト$$?
　Rushing back to HQ so suddenly?」

stage0061_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just wanted a word with Commander Ikari.」

stage0061_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Must've been pretty urgent.
　Showing up without any notice.」

stage0061_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This is strategy too.
　Keeps the enemy from bracing themselves.」

stage0061_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミサト$$
（The Ring of 12,000 Years...
　Commander Ikari once said those
　same words, '12,000 years'...）

stage0061_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
（I'm sure the Commander knows something...
　I'll find out.）

stage0061_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$加持$$
「Seems your plan's gonna fizzle out.」

stage0061_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Why are you even here!?
　You're assigned to the Euro Branch!」

stage0061_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$加持$$
「Special orders.
　I'm stationed at HQ for a while.」

stage0061_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$加持$$
「Now Katsuragi, me, and Ricchan can hang out
　together, just like back in school.」

stage0061_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$リツコ$$
「FYI, he's been stationed here over a month.」

stage0061_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Would you have rushed over if I had?」

stage0061_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$加持$$
「Then I blew it.
　Missed out on a warm welcome, huh.」

stage0061_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$加持$$
「Well, never mind.
　Anyway, the Commanders left on urgent business today.」

stage0061_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ミサト$$
（There's no way the Commander, with
　connections everywhere, doesn't know about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$... yet he's away now...）

stage0061_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$加持$$
「Don't expect much from me.
　I didn't ask where they're headed.」

stage0061_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So, where are you off to?」

stage0061_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$加持$$
「Just a walk.
　There's someone I want to see.」

stage0061_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$加持$$
「I'll be back by night.
　Let's grab a drink somewhere.」

stage0061_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Still as hard to pin down as ever...」

stage0061_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Call it youthful folly, shall we?
　Or is there still a spark left?」

stage0061_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Quit it...!
　I've got enough headaches lying around already.」

stage0061_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Man, this feels so weird.
　The Red Sea from our world is treated
　like a tourist spot over here.」

stage0061_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$n
「It's a rare phenomenon, after all.
　People'll probably come see it for a while yet.」

stage0061_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シンジ$$
「She had business, so she's at NERV HQ.」

stage0061_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$くらら$$
「Well, it's fine, isn't it.
　We got a ride out here too, after all.」

stage0061_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Today's a picnic, so let's forget
　about Volunteer Club work and just enjoy it.」

stage0061_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「There you go, $n.
　Seems we're off litter duty today.」

stage0061_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$n
「Hearing that leaves me a bit at loose ends.」

stage0061_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$n
「And I brought gloves and trash bags for nothing.」

stage0061_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「You're way too fired up, $n!」

stage0061_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「With $$アルト$$ off in space right now,
　I'll protect the Volunteer Club.」

stage0061_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You've really got that work ethic down.」

stage0061_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Surprising, $$アスカ$$.
　Picnics don't seem like your style.」

stage0061_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Can't be helped.
　$$ミサト$$ forced me to come.」

stage0061_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$葵$$
「But there's a lavish perk for anyone who joins.」

stage0061_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「All right, everyone...
　it's the lunchtime you've been waiting for.」

stage0061_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$甲児$$
「This time, $$ジョニー$$, $$郁絵$$, and I all had
　plans, so $$シンジ$$ made all the lunches.」

stage0061_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$さやか$$
「Amazing...!
　Tricolor rice balls, fried chicken,
　thick omelet, even crab and octopus wieners!」

stage0061_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Impressive, $$シンジ$$.
　You really understand what a picnic
　lunch is all about.」

stage0061_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't really know much about bentos,
　so I just followed a cookbook...」

stage0061_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's eat already!
　Just looking at it's making me hungry!」

stage0061_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I-I thought so last time too, it's decent.」

stage0061_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$n
（Eating that eagerly, no amount of
　playing it cool is gonna work.）

stage0061_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$n
（Could it be, $$甲児$$...
　did you plan this, leaving the lunch to $$シンジ$$?）

stage0061_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Flavor soaked all the way through, and
　the surface is fragrant! Truly exquisite!」

stage0061_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I simmered it slow, then seared it.」

stage0061_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「You've got skill, $$シンジ$$.
　Finishing it this well without falling apart.」

stage0061_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The cookbook had tips on it.」

stage0061_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$n
「Just getting to eat your cooking made
　this picnic worth coming to.」

stage0061_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, $n.
　What happened to $$かなめ$$ today?」

stage0061_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「Chidori's been busy in her own way.
　Lately she rushes home right after school.」

stage0061_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Maybe she's lonely with $$宗介$$ gone.」

stage0061_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I made plenty for both $$甲児$$ and
　you, $n, so please eat as much as you like.」

stage0061_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$加持$$
「Pardon me...
　mind if I have a little too?」

stage0061_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$加持$$
「Playing guardian must be tough, but
　there's no need for such caution, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0061_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$加持$$
「May I also call you Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0061_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$加持$$
「'Mister' stings a bit, $$竹尾ワッ太$$.」

stage0061_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$加持$$
「My name's $$加持リョウジ$$.
　I work for NERV.」

stage0061_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$加持$$
「I'm also an old friend of Katsuragi's.
　I know all about her bad sleeping habits, too.」

stage0061_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, you get it?」

stage0061_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Don't you dare laugh silently!」

stage0061_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$加持$$
「Now that introductions are done,
　I'll try your cooking, $$碇シンジ$$.」

stage0061_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$加持$$
「Delicious.
　Simple dish, but perfectly cooked and seasoned.」

stage0061_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$加持$$
「Nice work, $$シンジ$$.
　A man who stands in the kitchen is popular.」

stage0061_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$トウジ$$
「No way! I ain't standin' in no kitchen!」

stage0061_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$トウジ$$
「What'd you say!?
　Havin' principles matters, y'know!」

stage0061_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$n
「Both of you, quit it.
　You're ruining a perfectly good meal.」

stage0061_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$n
「Uh, yeah...
　it's more like outdoor cooking, though...」

stage0061_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Did you feed that nurse of yours?」

stage0061_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No use covering it up.
　I've had reports that you were seen
　out on a date with that person.」

stage0061_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「Well... it's not that I was hiding it...」

stage0061_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「Sorry...!
　I'll go get us something to drink!」

stage0061_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$シンジ$$
「There's tea in the water bottle already...」

stage0061_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$甲児$$
（Hey, hey... looks like this side's getting
　interesting too）

stage0061_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$葵$$
（But not being able to tell Miss $$スズネ$$
　about it... that's the complicated part）

stage0061_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry, Ayanami.
　Guess it wasn't to your taste...」

stage0061_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「No.
　I just don't eat meat.」

stage0061_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why apologize when you did nothing wrong!」

stage0061_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Besides, living things survive by eating others!
　Eat every last bit of that life, don't waste any!」

stage0061_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's with that look?
　You looking for a fight, Teacher's Pet?」

stage0061_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You oughta be used to it by now.
　It's nothing new.」

stage0061_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's gotten a bit windy, Ayanami.
　Drink some miso soup.
　It'll warm you up.」

stage0061_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
（...I can't believe even Miss $$スズネ$$
　knows about $$マキ$$...）

stage0061_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$n
（But there was no need to run away...）

stage0061_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right...
　the Sidereal are closing in.」

stage0061_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't move.
　I'll just touch your head a moment.」

stage0061_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you've calmed down.
　That's a welcome thing.」

stage0061_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Honestly, I would have liked to try
　$$碇シンジ$$'s cooking myself.」

stage0061_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you're wary of me.
　...can't blame you...」

stage0061_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$n
「Good, I'll take this chance to ask you.
　Just what you and Chrono are.」

stage0061_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$n
「We also know that you're connected
　to Geminis as well.」

stage0061_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The result of $$ゼロ$$'s investigation...
　As expected of him...」

stage0061_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No wonder, seeing as he killed a god...」

stage0061_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「Just what are you?
　How much do you actually know?」

stage0061_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Calm down, $n.
　I came here to tell you that.」

stage0061_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$n
「Aren't you here to team up with
　Geminis and crush us?」

stage0061_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...those connected to them
　are a faction within Chrono.」

stage0061_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　Chrono is split into two factions internally.」

stage0061_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And the faction opposing me
　is cooperating with Geminis, trying to
　accept the Prison of Time.」

stage0061_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$n
「What on earth for!?
　You called yourselves watchers over
　humanity's evolution, didn't you!」

stage0061_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「They caused $$時空震動$$, warping the world's memories...
　They must have yielded to that mighty power.」

stage0061_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$n
「Just what are you...?
　Giving up on your own and handing Earth
　over to them on your own terms...!」

stage0061_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$n
「Using words like 'watching over' us,
　when really you think you're secretly
　steering humanity's history!」

stage0061_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I have no intention of 'steering' anything.
　We won't abandon our stance as watchers.」

stage0061_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But things are accelerating.
　The 12,000-year ring of fate
　is about to close, after all.」

stage0061_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$n
「That word... $$グーラ$$ and $$ロジャー$$ said it too...」

stage0061_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Paradigm City's negotiator, is it.
　He too has the right to know that.」

stage0061_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The ring of fate is closing...
　$$バアル$$'s appearances are proof of it.」

stage0061_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$n
「Humanity's natural enemy...
　Just what is this ring of fate!?」

stage0061_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That answer is one you must find yourselves.
　As those branded with the $$烙印$$.」

stage0061_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Hard to believe right away, is it?」

stage0061_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But $n... for now, just hear me out.
　As one who shares the same goal.」

stage0061_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　I too am a cursed existence, just like you.」

stage0061_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's why I'm after them... what you call angels.」

stage0061_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The reaction's growing stronger...
　So they've come close by, then.」

stage0061_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$加持$$
「Are you looking at the world born beyond the Red Sea?」

stage0061_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's not like that...
　Not much good happened over there, anyway...」

stage0061_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$加持$$
「Katsuragi told me once.
　Looking at the blue sea in this world reminds
　her of the one she came from... 15 years ago.」

stage0061_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$加持$$
「Did you hear why Katsuragi joined NERV?」

stage0061_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$加持$$
「Katsuragi's father lived only in his own research,
　in a dream world, they say. She hated a father
　like that... maybe even despised him, I think.」

stage0061_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$加持$$
「But during $$セカンドインパクト$$,
　Katsuragi was saved by her father.」

stage0061_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$加持$$
「Surviving means a lot of different things.
　You have to accept the sacrifice of the dead
　and carry on their will.」

stage0061_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$加持$$
「Even more so if you're alone.
　You're not the only one it's hard for.」

stage0061_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why are you telling me this...?」

stage0061_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So this is where you were, Daddy's Boy!
　Come on, let's go!」

stage0061_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's $$第３新東京市$$!
　Geminis is headed there!」

stage0061_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$加持$$
（A watcher, is it...
　Their target's probably that after all...）

stage0061_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$加持$$
「Good work, $$シンジ$$.
　You really outdid yourself today.」

stage0061_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I just did what I had to.」

stage0061_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$加持$$
「But there are people your effort saved.
　Look...」

stage0061_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
Citizen
「Um, excuse me... are you the one who was
　riding that purple robot?」

stage0061_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
Citizen
「I was scared, but since you helped me, mister,
　I managed to hold on somehow.」

stage0061_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
Citizen
「Thank you so much.
　Well then, excuse me.」

stage0061_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Before... I got punched once
　just for having piloted an EVA.」

stage0061_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...But if I get stronger and can protect
　someone, I get thanked like that, huh.」

stage0061_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$加持$$
「You're doing great, $$シンジ$$.
　See... thanks to that, all your friends are safe.」

stage0061_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Way to go, $$シンジ$$.
　I got your whole performance on camera.」

stage0061_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Man, I still can't believe it, even now.
　$$シンジ$$, fighting alongside $$甲児$$,
　$n, and the others.」

stage0061_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$トウジ$$
「But hey, thanks.
　My sister, who's in the hospital here,
　pulled through thanks to $c too.」

stage0061_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シンジ$$
（$$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$ and the others
　don't know about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ or $$バアル$$...）

stage0061_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I wonder if we can protect them...
　Everyone... and this world...）

stage0061_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$トウジ$$
「All that evacuating's got me starving.
　Is there any lunch left?」

stage0061_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Yeah.
　Guess I made a bit too much, after all.」

stage0061_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Bring it on!
　I'll polish off every last bit!」

stage0061_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Alright, on to round two of lunchtime.」

stage0061_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$トウジ$$
「We'll go grab a bench over there!
　We'll be waiting, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0061_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$加持$$
「Lively bunch, huh.
　That's junior high boys for you.」

stage0061_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$加持$$
「I get why you're anxious, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0061_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$加持$$
「But you're not the one fighting alone.
　Everyone in $c, Katsuragi, me too...」

stage0061_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$加持$$, do you happen to know
　where my father went?」

stage0061_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$加持$$
「I've got a rough idea.
　Commander Ikari's probably working for this world.」

stage0061_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$加持$$
「Well then, I'll head back to HQ.
　Oh... let $c know
　Katsuragi might not be back today...」

stage0061_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$加持$$
「Just kidding...
　Well, who knows how it'll turn out, though.」

stage0061_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Before we head back, $$トウジ$$ and I are finishing
　the leftover lunch. Come too, Ayanami, if you'd like.」

stage0061_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Wait for me, okay?
　I'll go get Shikinami and $n and the others.」

stage0061_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「So the construction of Mark.06 continues, does it?」

stage0061_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Understood.
　Then we'll proceed with the schedule as is.」

stage0061_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Both $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$
　are meaningless before our plan.」

stage0061_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Then, this concludes the regular report session.」

stage0061_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Perhaps it should be called a tribunal instead.」

stage0061_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$冬月$$
「Mark.06...
　There was never meant to be a plan past Unit-05.」

stage0061_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There's likely an undisclosed Apocrypha
　of the Dead Sea Scrolls. $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$ intends to
　proceed with a scenario based on it.」

stage0061_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$冬月$$
「But surely even $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$ has noticed
　NERV's ultimate purpose...」

stage0061_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Even if that's so,
　we'll simply walk our own path.
　Even if it means opposing the Providence of God...」

stage0061_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$冬月$$
「The South Pole of this world, huh...」

stage0061_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$冬月$$
「The world we came from was pretty awful too, though.」

stage0061_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There are those who wished for that catastrophe.
　A world even people cannot set foot in,
　purified and cleansed of original sin.」

stage0061_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$冬月$$
「I'd rather have a chaotic world, tainted by people.」

stage0061_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Chaos is nothing but a human impression.
　The world is built entirely on harmony and order.」

stage0061_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Indeed, something like $c has come into being.」

stage0061_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$冬月$$
「But there are also those who oppose it.」

stage0061_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That too could be called harmony.」

stage0061_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$冬月$$
「People's hearts disturb the world... is that it?」

stage0061_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「But that, too, will soon come to an end...
　As the 12,000-year ring closes.」

stage0061_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, if it isn't Lady $$レイ#333$$...
　Fancy meeting you in a place like this.」

stage0061_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand more or less what's happening.
　It's odd for a robot like me to say so,
　but that's a normal human reaction.」

stage0061_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was a rather systematic way to put it.
　Humans call that emotion, or the heart stirring.」

stage0061_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Proof of that: thanks to you, Lady $$レイ#333$$,
　a 100Z Z-Chip was born.
　I'll add it to the squad's stock.」

stage0061_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes!
　It must be just like you feel right now.」

stage0061_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Welcome back, Lady $$ミサト$$.
　You came home quite late last night.」

stage0061_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What...
　I'm a grown adult too, so it's fine if I
　want to stay out late or come home at dawn.」

stage0061_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, I'm not scolding you for that.
　I just wanted to give you this.」

stage0061_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's clam miso soup Master $$シンジ$$ made.
　He asked me to give it to you, Lady $$ミサト$$,
　whenever you showed up.」

stage0061_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For a hangover, clam amino acids
　really do work wonders, you know.」

stage0061_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry for taking it out on you too, $$ＡＧ$$.
　...Last night's drinking almost turned into
　a hassle, so I guess it went to my head.」

stage0061_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Lady $$ミサト$$...
　As an adult, you must have all sorts of stress, but...」

stage0061_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if you drink too much,
　the aftermath can be quite rough.」

stage0061_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Thanks for the advice, and the soup too.」

stage0061_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome.
　Now, I'll get back to my usual business.」

stage0061_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So-o-o then!!
　Let's get pumped toda-a-ay... business, business!!」

stage0061_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't shout right in my ear!!」
